description: This file defines a class StaticCredentialsProvider that provides static AWS credentials within the AWS CRT PHP SDK. It manages AWS credentials such as access key ID, secret access key, and session token, and implements credential provision functionality.

classes.name: StaticCredentialsProvider
classes.description: Provides a static set of AWS credentials by implementing CredentialsProvider, allowing use of fixed AWS access credentials within applications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the credentials provider with specified AWS credentials using provided options array.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic getter to access private properties of the class.
